title: Dashboard application shell, navigation and theming
description: The Next.js 15 shell: authenticated layout, navigation, theme switching, tenant switcher, and the loading and error boundaries every subsequent screen inherits.
acceptance: App Router with server components by default; client components only where interaction requires
Dark default with a working light mode, persisted per user
Responsive from 375px upward with no horizontal scroll
Error and loading boundaries at every route segment
Navigation reflects the user's role; an unauthorised route is refused server-side, not merely hidden

tests.desc: Authenticated navigation works across every top-level route
Theme preference persists across sessions
axe accessibility checks pass on the shell in both themes
Direct navigation to an unauthorised route is refused server-side

title: Case list with filtering, sorting and live updates
description: The main working surface: open cases ranked by severity and score, filterable, updating live as new cases arrive.
acceptance: Filter by severity, status, entity, rule and date range
New cases appear without a manual refresh
Pagination performs acceptably at 10,000 cases
Empty, loading and error states are designed, not default
Keyboard navigable end to end

tests.desc: Filters produce correct result sets
A new case appears live without refresh
List renders responsively at 10,000 cases
Full keyboard navigation of the list and its filters

title: Case detail view with inline evidence
description: The screen that makes the grounding guarantee visible: the plain-English report, with every claim expandable to the exact log events that prove it.
acceptance: The report is presented in plain English with a timeline of the case
Every claim expands to show the referenced raw events
The MITRE technique for each signal is shown with a plain-English explanation
Recommended actions are presented with their blast radius and an approval control
The full case history including every state transition is viewable

tests.desc: Expanding a claim displays the referenced events
A claim whose evidence is still indexing shows a pending state, not an error
Approving an action from this screen executes the correct playbook
Accessibility checks pass on the expanded evidence view

title: Connector management and onboarding wizard
description: The brief promises 10-minute setup. A non-technical admin connects Microsoft 365 without reading documentation.
acceptance: The wizard explains in plain language what permissions are requested and why
Connection status, last sync and health are clearly visible
A failed or revoked connection states what to do, not just that it failed
Disconnecting explains exactly what stops happening
An unassisted non-technical user completes it in under 10 minutes

tests.desc: The full connection flow completes against a test tenant
A revoked connection surfaces actionable recovery guidance
Five non-technical testers complete setup unassisted in under 10 minutes

title: Free 10-minute security scan
description: The commercial centrepiece. Connect, replay the last 7 days through detection, and present real findings. The go-to-market plan assumes this converts 1 in 4 trials.
acceptance: Connect to scan results in under 10 minutes for a 100-seat tenant
Findings are presented in business terms with estimated exposure, not technical counts
A shareable report is produced that an owner can forward internally
Honest when nothing serious is found — the product must not manufacture urgency
Conversion from scan to trial is instrumented end to end

tests.desc: Scan completes inside 10 minutes for a 100-seat tenant
A seeded tenant with known issues surfaces exactly those issues
A clean tenant produces an honest clean result with no invented findings
Conversion funnel events fire at each step

title: MSP multi-client console
description: The primary customer segment manages 20 to 200 clients. One screen showing every client's posture, with cross-tenant access strictly scoped to linked clients.
acceptance: A single view ranks all linked clients by open critical cases
Drilling into a client enters that tenant's scope cleanly and visibly
Cross-client search covers only linked clients
Performance is acceptable at 200 clients
An MSP user cannot reach a tenant they are not linked to, enforced server-side

tests.desc: Console renders 200 clients within the performance budget
Direct API access to an unlinked tenant is refused
Drill-down and return preserve correct tenant scope
Unlinking a client immediately removes access

title: Weekly owner report
description: The brief's one-page weekly summary in simple language: what happened, what was blocked, and the one thing to improve.
acceptance: Generated weekly per tenant on a configurable schedule
Fits one page and names exactly one improvement, not a list
Delivered by email with a dashboard copy and a PDF export
Readability is checked against the same threshold as case reports
A week with nothing to report says so plainly rather than padding

tests.desc: Report generates correctly from a seeded week
A quiet week produces an honest low-activity report
PDF export renders correctly
Readability threshold is met

title: Dismissal digest and suppression management UI
description: Makes the 'nothing is hidden' guarantee visible and actionable: what was dismissed, why, and the ability to challenge it.
acceptance: Daily dismissals are browsable and grouped by reason
Each dismissal shows whether a rule or the AI closed it, and why
A dismissal can be challenged, reopening the case
Active suppressions are listed with their creator, reason and expiry
A suppression can be revoked from the UI

tests.desc: Dismissals are listed with their reasons
Challenging a dismissal reopens the case
Revoking a suppression takes effect on the next evaluation

title: Public API and OpenAPI specification
description: A documented, versioned API so MSPs can integrate with their own tooling — a frequent procurement requirement in this segment.
acceptance: OpenAPI specification is generated from code, not hand-maintained
API keys are scoped per tenant with configurable permissions
Rate limiting is applied per key and documented
Versioning policy is documented with a deprecation process
Every endpoint enforces tenant scoping independently of the key's claims

tests.desc: The generated specification matches actual endpoint behaviour
A key scoped to tenant A cannot read tenant B through any endpoint
Rate limiting returns 429 with correct headers
A revoked key is rejected immediately

title: Billing, plans and usage metering
description: The three pricing tiers from the brief, with usage metered against the per-tenant cost model so margin is visible per account.
acceptance: MSP, startup and small-business plans are modelled with their limits
Seat count and event volume are metered per tenant
Cost of goods per tenant is computed and compared to revenue
Plan limits are enforced with graceful degradation, not a hard stop
An operations view shows margin per tenant

tests.desc: Usage metering matches actual consumption
Exceeding a plan limit degrades gracefully and notifies
Margin calculation is correct for each plan tier

title: Accessibility audit and remediation
description: WCAG 2.1 AA across the product. A security console that fails colour-blind users is failing roughly 8% of its operators on the one dimension that matters most: severity.
acceptance: Every screen meets WCAG 2.1 AA
Severity is never conveyed by colour alone, verified on every surface
Full keyboard operation of every workflow including approval
Screen reader walkthrough of the critical path is completed and recorded
Automated accessibility checks run in CI and gate the build

tests.desc: Automated axe checks pass on every route
Screen reader walkthrough of case review and approval
Colour-blindness simulation review of every severity surface
Approval workflow completes using keyboard only

title: Pilot onboarding and feedback instrumentation
description: The P6 exit criterion made measurable: track time to first value, and capture structured feedback from the 5 to 10 pilot customers.
acceptance: Time from signup to first connector and to first case is measured
Drop-off points in onboarding are instrumented
In-product feedback capture is attached to cases and reports
False-positive reports from customers feed the tuning backlog automatically
A pilot dashboard shows progress against each success criterion

tests.desc: Onboarding funnel events fire at each step
A customer false-positive report creates a tuning backlog item
Pilot dashboard reflects seeded metric values correctly

title: End-to-end self-serve onboarding test
description: The P6 exit criterion as an automated test: signup to connector to scan to first case to weekly report, unassisted.
acceptance: Covers signup, connector consent, scan, first case and weekly report
Asserts the whole path completes in under 15 minutes of wall-clock
Runs against a real Microsoft test tenant, not a mock
Runs nightly and gates the release
Failure identifies which step broke

tests.desc: Full onboarding path completes within 15 minutes
A weekly report is generated for the new tenant
Failure reporting correctly identifies a deliberately broken step
